text:
Leah: Last planning thread before we finalize the March webinar run-of-show. Short checklist: topic order, confirmed speakers, demo failover owner, rehearsal windows. Reply with brief ack or the one change you own.

Tom: Short keynote please. 15/25/20? Audience retention data supports shorter intros.

Priya: 15/25/20 works. We need the demo to show both latency and cost edge-cases. I'll script the demo prompts.

Ravi: I'll own the failover toggle and a 1-line scrub script to run pre-demo. Plan: Dedicated pool -> hosted quantized -> EU warm cache.

Ava: Speakers: Sarah & Miguel confirmed. Oliver verbally agreed; need slides. I'll chase and request by Wed noon. Design will make infographic for slide + landing.

Ethan: I'll moderate the panel and field Qs. Routing: register -> SFDC campaign "webinar-march-26". Ops, confirm reg->SFDC mapping and demo click tags?

Ops: Confirmed. We will tag leads with "interest_level" and "demo_click" and map ARR band to SDR queues. Recording retention: 90 days default.

Leah: Draft run-of-show (minutes):
```
0:00-0:02 Welcome + housekeeping (Leah)
0:02-0:17 Keynote: cost-aware inference (Sarah)
0:17-0:42 Live demo: Dedicated vs Hosted (Miguel + Ravi)
0:42-0:56 Panel: latency & cost tradeoffs (Oliver, Sarah, Miguel)
0:56-1:00 Close + CTA + lead routing (Leah + Ethan)
```
If we do 15/25/20, keynote is 15 and demo becomes 25.

Tom: Add a 2-min poll after keynote (PoC / Scaling / Security) to help SDR routing.

Priya: Also propose a fixed 50-token prompt for the demo so we can repeat and surface latency/cost metrics. I'll post it.

Ravi: Failover quick notes: flip to hosted quantized on timeout, fallback region if needed. Will add toggle in greenroom and a short playbook.

Ava: Rehearsals: tech check 30m (2 days prior), full dress 60m (1 day prior), final mic check 15m (1h prior). Proposed times: Tue 4pm PT, Wed 9am PT, Thu 9:45am PT. Miguel can't do Tue morning; fine for Wed/Thu.

Ethan: Lead routing detail: "request demo" -> SDR A if ARR >100k else SDR B. Need hidden ARR band on reg form. Ops can implement?

Ops: Yes, we'll create queues and mapping by arr_band field. Demo clicks logged as activity, campaign assigned.

Leah: Action items: Ava: infographic + chase slides (Mon EOD). Priya: demo prompt + expected outputs (Fri). Ravi: failover toggle + scrub script (Wed). Ethan: panel moderation + routing confirmation. Ops: SFDC queues + form mapping (Tue). Speakers: sign consent + upload slides (Wed noon).

Tom: ack

Priya: ack, will post prompt in #marketing-assets.

Ravi: ack, pushing scripts to /rehearsals/demo-fallbacks.

Ava: ack, looping in design.

Oliver: I will upload slides by Wed noon and sign consent.

Leah: Thanks all. Calendar invites coming. :sparkles:
